$comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for every case-study metric on this site.
WHY THIS FILE EXISTS. These metrics used to be prose, typed into 25+ places.
A PageSpeed claim drifted upward on its own across surfaces: a 90+ baseline
became 97/100 on one page and '100 PageSpeed' on another, which contradicts
brand canon. On 4 Aug 2026 five service surfaces withdrew the MyCustomPatches
performance figures while the case study, the work index and llms.txt kept
asserting them. Four surfaces disagreed with five about one client's numbers.
THE RULE. A metric appears here once. Every surface renders from here:
page title, meta description, OG, Twitter, body, work-index cards, schema.
No metric is ever typed into a page file again.
STATUS. 'verified' renders the number and MUST carry a method.
'withdrawn' renders the dated withdrawal note INSTEAD of the number, on every
surface at once. Flipping one field flips the whole site in one deploy.
ENFORCEMENT. scripts/metrics_guard.py reads this file and the built HTML and
fails the build if a withdrawn value appears anywhere, or a verified metric
renders without its method. Drift is now a build error, not a memory.
RELATIONSHIP. Every case study declares one, and it renders on the page.
Added 10 Aug 2026 after an audit found 3 of 6 /work pages carrying NO
relationship disclosure at all: mycustompatches (the independent-client
proof, which never said so on its own page), panda-codelab (founder-
affiliated, disclosed in llms.txt but not on the page), and enterprise-ops
(presented as client work; it is the internal CRM for Panda Patches).
`disclosure` is the sentence surfaces render verbatim. scripts/link_guard.py
fails the build if a /work page renders without it.

metrics.label: Live integrations
metrics.value: Square payments, ZeptoMail transactional email, Meta CAPI, Sentry

method.note: Code search plus the live Edge Function listing, 15 September 2026. Square is live and Stripe is decommissioned; the only remaining Stripe reference in the CRM repository is a comment describing what replaced it. Meta CAPI runs across six active functions. Sentry is initialised in src/main.tsx and proxied first-party. Transactional email runs through the single send-email function on ZeptoMail. That the customer is emailed a paid invoice once payment lands is stated by the platform's owner rather than confirmed by that repository audit, which did not enumerate the email templates; it is consistent with the invoice PDF renderer and the unpaid-invoice dashboard already in the stack, and should be confirmed against the template list on the next pass.

metrics.label: Legacy production rows imported

method.note: Stated by the CRM repository's own source audit, 15 September 2026, answering a written evidence request from this site. The physical production floor had run on a Google Sheet since August 2025. Its rows were imported into the production_rows table and reconciled line for line against the workbook. Twenty blank rows produced by the sheet's own fill-down were identified and deleted separately, logged with their sheet-line numbers so the reconciliation still ties.

metrics.approvedBy: PandaCodeGen engineering, from the CRM repository

metrics.label: Patch-type spellings normalised

method.note: Stated by the CRM repository's own source audit, 15 September 2026, answering a written evidence request from this site. The production_type_rules and production_type_aliases tables collapse the spreadsheet's 27 raw spellings, case- and punctuation-insensitively, into 13 canonical types through the production_canonical_type() function. A blank type resolves to NULL and falls back to manual pricing rather than blocking the row.
